model_limits: Reconstructed from the EV S-181 data sheet envelope and the NNC record of the modified cabinet. Nothing in this model has been checked against a physical unit; every placement is approximate.

category_limits.Connections: Socket function labels follow the NNC record of the modified plate. The plate pinout is unmetered and connector positions in this reconstruction are approximate.

sources.label: Electro-Voice S-181 service data / specification sheet (spec 1043-1731)
sources.scope: Published frequency response, power handling, sensitivity, impedance, 70.1 × 53.8 × 58.2 cm envelope and 30.9 kg net weight. Pages 2 to 4 are image scans and were not machine-read.

sources.label: NNC gear pack · catalog-seed.json · ev-s181-bauder
sources.scope: Unit identity, DL18MT driver, factory 1/4-inch INPUT and OUTPUT jacks, three added round NL4-style sockets, quantity planning and open gaps.

sources.label: Modified EV S181 (Bauder) record
sources.locator: NNC equipment record and Dave's cabinet photographs, October 2026
sources.scope: Lettering and recorded roles of the added sockets: A upper LOW, B lower LOW, C HI. The real pinout has not been metered.

components.label: Bandpass cabinet
components.purpose: Single-18 bandpass subwoofer enclosure, 538 wide × 701 high × 582 deep mm and 30.9 kg net. The driver sits inside a sealed chamber and fires into a vented front chamber, so the only openings you see are the front vents and the rear connector recess.
components.limits: Envelope and weight are published. Vent shape, corner hardware, handles and panel recesses are approximate and unverified against Nick's cabinets.

components.label: DL18MT 18-inch driver
components.purpose: One 18-inch DL18MT woofer, 8 ohms nominal with an 8.0 ohm minimum, rated 400 W long-term and 1600 W short-term per EIA RS-426A. Sensitivity is 98 dB at 1 W / 1 m. Usable response is 48 to 200 Hz (-3 dB at 48 Hz, -10 dB at 36 Hz) and EV recommends a 200 Hz crossover.
components.limits: The driver is hidden inside the bandpass chamber; its position and mounting in this model are illustrative. Driver condition, recone history and the exact DL18MT variant are unknown.

components.label: Factory 1/4-inch INPUT jack
components.purpose: Original EV 1/4-inch phone jack feeding the driver. The cabinet is passive, so this carries amplifier output, not line level.

components.label: Factory 1/4-inch OUTPUT jack
components.purpose: Original EV 1/4-inch parallel-through jack for daisy-chaining a second cabinet on the same amplifier channel. Two 8 ohm cabinets in parallel present 4 ohms to the amplifier.

components.label: Added socket A · upper LOW
components.purpose: Upper of the two added round NL4-style sockets recorded as LOW on the Bauder plate. Which pins reach the driver, and whether A and B are wired in parallel, has not been metered.
components.limits: Recorded role only. Pinout, polarity and internal wiring are unmetered.

components.label: Added socket B · lower LOW
components.purpose: Lower of the two added round NL4-style sockets recorded as LOW. Treat it as a second LOW entry or link until the plate is metered.
components.limits: Recorded role only. Pinout, polarity and internal wiring are unmetered.

components.label: Added socket C · HI
components.purpose: Added round NL4-style socket recorded as HI. A HI socket on a passive subwoofer usually passes the top-cabinet feed through the plate rather than reaching the driver, but that is an inference, not a measurement.
components.limits: Recorded role only. Whether C is isolated from the driver, and which pins it uses, is unmetered.

evidence_policy.physical_verification: None; no dimension or placement has been checked against a physical cabinet
